description: This file defines the QueueEntity class, a JPA entity representing a queue in the database, including fields for tenant ID, name, topic, poll interval, partitions, processing strategies, and additional info. It provides methods to convert between the entity and the Queue data object.

classes.name: QueueEntity
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing a queue, with fields for queue properties and methods to convert to and from the Queue data object.
